facts.text: My arm and leg muscles are weak.
It's in the muscles near my shoulders and hips, the upper arms and thighs, on both sides.
I feel listless, with no energy.
After the ulcer was treated I still felt listless, and I had this weakness.
I've had several episodes of similar weakness before, brought on by exertion.
Three weeks ago an insect bit me on the left thigh.
The bite turned into a deep ulcer.
I needed surgery to clean out the ulcer.
I was given antibiotics for the ulcer.
I don't take any water pills.

facts.item: recent severe breathing problem with carbon dioxide build-up
facts.text: I haven't recently had any breathing failure or carbon dioxide build-up.

aliases: family history of kidney salt-wasting disorder
facts.text: Nobody in my family has had Bartter's syndrome.

findings.name: metabolic panel
findings.result: Potassium 1.31 mmol/L; magnesium low (hypomagnesemia); calcium low (hypocalcemia); urea 13 mg/dL; creatinine 0.72 mg/dL (renal function normal).

findings.name: spot urine electrolytes
findings.result: Urine chloride excretion >20 mEq/day; urine potassium excretion >30 mEq/day.

gold.reasoning: 1. Surreptitious diuretic use — “we excluded surreptitious diuretic use…” 2. Extracellular volume contraction — “we excluded…extracellular volume contraction (diarrhea or vomiting)…” 3. Post-hypercapnic state — “we excluded…a post-hypercapnic state.” 4. Liddle’s syndrome — “Patients with Gitelman’s syndrome are usually normotensive, which differentiate them from patients with Liddle’s syndrome.” 5. Bartter’s syndrome — “A family history of Bartter’s syndrome was absent and a provisional diagnosis of Gitelman’s syndrome was made.”

source_issues: s008 reports 'spot urine studies' in mEq/day, a unit for timed (24-hour) collections.
notes: Index visit: the presentation three weeks after the insect bite, with listlessness and proximal limb weakness after the ulcer had been debrided and treated with antibiotics (s001-s012).
The insect bite, the deep ulcer, its surgical debridement and the antibiotics happened before the index visit and are history facts, not excluded treatment.
s007 lists causes excluded 'by history'; each is an absent fact (no diuretics, diarrhoea, vomiting or recent hypercapnic state).
Urea, creatinine, potassium, magnesium and calcium are grouped as one metabolic panel; renin and aldosterone are two records sharing one source sentence.
